scope: TOTP setup key URIs and OTP code checks under the realm OTP policy: the QR code key URI under TOTP and HOTP policies with other algorithms, digits and periods, which setup and login codes the look-ahead window and HOTP counter accept, a credential keeping its policy after the realm changes, and code reuse.
normalization: The base URL and realm names are replaced with placeholders; pages are reduced by tests/page_texts.py without the language choice, with their form ids and list items sorted; the QR code is read into its key URI with the base32 secret as {secret}; redirects keep their path and whether they carry a code; credentials keep their type and credentialData.
